summary: On paper Cincinnati has the edge (Cincinnati's defense ranks 8th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.07 allowed). The model favors Cincinnati at 65%, mostly on starting QB (2.7 pts) and rushing matchup (2.3 pts).

CIN.detail: Cincinnati's defense ranks 8th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.07 allowed). Pittsburgh ranks 24th (+0.08).

PIT.detail: Pittsburgh ranks 24th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.08). Cincinnati's defense ranks 8th (+0.07 allowed).

team_cards.t1: Cincinnati has the 8th-best defense vs motion.
team_cards.t2: Pittsburgh has the 4th-worst motion passing game.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · CIN: n=35 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Cincinnati 65% to win, fair line CIN -4.5. Market: Cincinnati 62%. The largest factor is starting qb, worth 2.7 points toward Cincinnati.

model_cards.t1: The model agrees with the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Pittsburgh. Sum = CIN -4.5.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Pittsburgh's margin. Shaded area = Pittsburgh win (35%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Pittsburgh is missing 1.0 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 0.1 points toward Cincinnati.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Cincinnati's pass offense.
model_cards.t2: 0.06 EPA per play better than Pittsburgh's.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line
